blocks.text: 在我们的测试中，GPT Image 2.6 Flare 的速度几乎是 GPT Image 2.5 Flare 的两倍，同时质量略有提升。其中位文生图生成时间从约 55 秒降至 30 秒，编辑时间从约 58 秒降至 32 秒。GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst 则相反：它比 GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst 更慢，每张图约需 2 分 15 秒，并拿下第 1 名。它在文生图方面提升最大的是推理、文字渲染、光照与材质，并且在 UIUX 设计方面表现最强。

blocks.text: OpenAI released GPT Image 2.6 on November 4 in ChatGPT, Codex and the API. The API offers two models, GPT Image 2.6 Flare and GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst, which follow GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Sunburst. Both support Text to Image and Image Editing, and add animated GIF and SVG output. OpenAI added a complexity setting to the API, which controls how much the model plans before rendering. We benchmarked both models at max quality, with complexity at its API default of high.

inlines.text: OpenAI released GPT Image 2.6 on November 4 in ChatGPT, Codex and the API. The API offers two models, GPT Image 2.6 Flare and GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst, which follow GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Sunburst. Both support Text to Image and Image Editing, and add animated GIF and SVG output. OpenAI added a complexity setting to the API, which controls how much the model plans before rendering. We benchmarked both models at max quality, with complexity at its API default of high.

blocks.text: In our testing, GPT Image 2.6 Flare is almost twice as fast as GPT Image 2.5 Flare while delivering slightly better quality. Its median Text to Image generation time fell from about 55 to 30 seconds, and its editing time fell from about 58 to 32 seconds. GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst goes the other way: it takes longer than GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, at about 2 minutes 15 seconds per image, and takes the #1 spot. Its largest Text to Image gains are in Reasoning, Text Rendering, Lighting and Material, and it is strongest in UIUX Design.
